summary: Iteration 56 - CAPEX Intelligence Feature Testing. Backend: 11/14 tests passed (79%). Frontend: All CAPEX components working correctly. The 3 backend failures are related to staff role restriction testing - new user registrations automatically become 'owner' role, so testing 403 for staff requires using team management invite flow.

minor.issue: Cannot test 403 for staff users via direct registration - new users become 'owner' of their own org. Need to use team invite flow to create actual staff users.
